name: Mieders
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to the Stubaital gateway, featuring a summer sledding run, climbing park, and natural lake swimming area – perfect for family outings.
beschreibung:
Mieders is situated at an altitude of 952 meters right at the entrance to the Stubaital valley, conveniently located between Innsbruck and the heart of the Stubai Alps. With around 1,900 inhabitants, it is the first village welcoming visitors into the valley. Perched on a sunny terrace above the Wipptal, Mieders offers unobstructed views of the majestic Serles mountain, famously known as the 'High Altar of Tyrol'.

🌲 The Serlesbahnen cable car transports guests up to 1,600 meters in just a few minutes, where lush alpine pastures invite hikers in summer and family-friendly ski slopes await in winter. The Serles high-altitude plateau affords breathtaking panoramic vistas stretching across the Karwendel and Inn valley. Right at the base station lies one of the longest alpine summer toboggan runs in Tyrol, dropping over 1,000 meters of altitude across 2.8 scenic kilometers, alongside an adventure rope course and a natural bathing lake perfect for summer days.

Culinary offerings in Mieders are deeply rooted in alpine tradition: savory dumplings, Kaspressknödel soup, and sizzling Tiroler Gröstl grace the menus of local inns, made with fresh farm ingredients. Mieders preserves an authentic, nature-loving village charm that especially enchants families seeking mountain enjoyment.
